metadata.description: Directly installable Candidate reproducing MiaAI-Lab's current 2x DGX Spark EXL3/TR3 4 bpw target with the bf582e4e DFlash2 K7 checkpoint, native-mp TP2, 1M context, FP8 sparse-MLA target KV, BF16 draft KV, CUDA graphs, prefix caching, vision, reasoning, and tools. Exact source, image, target, drafter, licenses, and measured resource envelope are pinned; Vonk physical acceptance and checkpoint requalification remain pending.
